g.text: RISE / Heat prediction, checked against reality

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #636660

g.text: Public views only. Rolling-origin held-out counts; matched MAE is descriptive, not a model superiority claim.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #191b1b

g.text: Latest held-out examples | Torch when evaluated; otherwise recent-rate baseline

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #636660

g.text: Examples are selected by capture time, not error. Edited status IDs remain separate; missing publication times are excluded.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #636660

g.text: MAE bars use the same eligible origins within each horizon. Samples from one post do not prove performance on other posts.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #636660

g.text: Official popular-pool normalization: 8h half-life / 0.5h age floor / 24h window. This pool score is not a 24h forecast.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #21796f

g.text: Sparse single-account evidence. Content effects, independent audience conversion and causal growth remain unknown.
